reason: I already have my gummies and I just reorder them when they run out, so I'm not looking for another one. A box of 30 foil sachets also feels like a lot of trash for something I take once a day.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already have a routine with a brand I reorder.
would_change_my_mind: A refill or recyclable packaging option, or a clear reason it works better than what I already take.
